desc:
Play through 200 levels that get harder as you go. The first levels are easy, but they become very difficult. This game is made to be hard, and most players will not finish it. Be ready for tough challenges!

Ready to take on the stages? 💪

Like the game to support development 👍

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
